thread:
anya: Quick poll  do we want cold brew in the office tomorrow or just restock espresso beans? also FYI someone left a labeled jar 'Claire kimchi' on the counter :smile:

liam: kimchi?? hazardous or delightful? :thinking_face: either way, do not put kimchi in the shared fridge drawer labeled 'desserts' :scream:

jo: I will NEVER forgive the last person who used the crema brush as a spoon. vote: restock beans (espresso) + new brush.

pat: I can pick up beans on my 5pm errands. which roast? house medium or dark roast?

anya: medium house roast please. also @ops-bot when did we last replace the water filter on the brewer?

ops-bot: Kitchen maintenance log: water_filter_last_replaced=2025-08-03, next_scheduled=2026-02-01. Alert: filter due in 9 months.

claire: kimchi is mine, lab experiment leftover, labeled and sealed. pls don't panic, it's mild. I'll move it to my desk if anyone's worried. also free samples if someone wants to try. :v:

liam: sample request noted. will try post-standup.

jo: on the coffee front: can we also get a squeegee for the espresso puck drawer? little grounds everywhere.

pat: adding squeegee + new crema brush + 1 bag medium espresso beans to my list. anyone want pastry? there's a bakery two blocks away with good savoury tarts.

anya: pastries yes. savory tart vote: spinach feta OR mushroom thyme?

claire: mushroom thyme for me. spinach makes me sleepy. :sleeping:

liam: spinach feta hands down. breakfast power.

jo: split decision. can we compromise: 6 spinach feta + 6 mushroom thyme? harmony achieved.

pat: compromise accepted. I will post receipt and Venmo split when back. total estimate $33.10.

ops-bot: Inventory snapshot: oat_milk=4, whole_milk=2, espresso_beans=0.6kg, seltzer_cans=8, stirrers=10. Reminder scheduled: beans_low_threshold=0.7kg.

anya: note for etiquette: please wipe the steam wand after each use. i cleaned it twice this morning and it was still crusty. :grimacing:

claire: agreed. i'll pin a 1-line sign: "Wipe steam wand. Please." on the machine. also bringing small jar of kimchi samples with labels.

liam: receipt posted: https://imgur.com/coffee_run_221111 (total $33.10). pat pls confirm and i'll send $16.55.

pat: confirmed. sent request. thanks team.

jo: new sign mockup: "This machine is loved. Treat it kindly. Wipe the wand. Return portafilter." i'll print and tape tonight.

anya: love that. last ask: can someone put a tiny note on the fridge "Personal items: label with name"? saves mystery jars.

claire: will do. kimchi will have a neon sticky with my name. sorry for the fermentation suspense.

liam: mission accomplished. pastry ETA ~22 minutes. picture or it didn't happen. :camera_with_flash:
